title: Two-pass loudness master, SFX levelling, cue verification
what_it_does: master.sh (two-pass loudnorm with true-peak limiter), level-sfx.mjs (level the asset, not the cue volume), verify-cue.sh (prove a cue is audible in the delivered file).
when_to_use: Final audio mastering of any piece.
why: Real lessons encoded (clipping after a louder SFX, limiter makeup gain). Check against hyperframes `normalize-audio` first; keep what that does not do.
